error.invalid_pin: The Bluetooth Passcode must be a number of up to 6 digits

pin.description:
Chargers on firmware 6.11 or newer (all Pulsar Max and Pulsar Pro built after 1 August 2025) require a 6-digit Bluetooth Passcode. Find it in the Wallbox app on the charger information page. Leave this empty if your charger does not have one.

If the charger is reached through an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy rather than a local Bluetooth adapter, the passcode must also be configured on the proxy — see the integration's README.

reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected the stored Bluetooth Passcode. Check it in the Wallbox app on the charger information page and enter it again.

reconfigure.description: Update the Bluetooth Passcode for {name}. Leave this empty if the charger does not have one.
